description: This file defines the 'PayGradeController' class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It extends an abstract controller class and overrides the preRender method to initialize and set a Vue component named 'pay-grade-list'.

classes.name: PayGradeController
classes.description: Controller managing the Pay Grade view, initializing the Vue component for the pay-grade list.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Overrides the parent's method to set up the 'pay-grade-list' Vue component before rendering.
